product_one_liner.value: Ethos uses AI to connect professionals with paid consulting, advisory and employment opportunities while helping investors, enterprises and AI labs find relevant human expertise.

pricing_page.notes: Ethos Evals publishes usage-based pricing, including a $0 platform fee and a 30% markup on model token cost.

named_customers.notes: Both appear under 'COMPANIES HIRING WITH ETHOS' on its recruiting site.

employee_band.notes: Public headcount sources conflict and do not establish one of the requested employee bands.

founded_year.notes: 2024 is stated in funding coverage and the investor's company profile.

eng_blog.notes: The readable updates index contains product announcements and release notes, not engineering implementation posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: Ethos Evals provides public MCP setup, authentication, workflow and tool-reference documentation, alongside benchmark and pricing guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: An application-enabled Data Scientist expert-contract opportunity is listed under Ethos for client language-model training work; it is not an internal engineering position.

model_provider.value: Anthropic; Google Gemini; Groq; OpenAI; OpenRouter
model_provider.notes: Disclosed as AI subprocessors; OpenRouter is identified as a model gateway and routing service.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims GDPR compliance, not a third-party GDPR certification. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 appear as conditional examples rather than unequivocal claims of achieved certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The May 6, 2026 Series A falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Accepting applications for Enterprise Account Executive (B2B) expert work supporting a client AI lab; this is not evidence of an internal quota-carrying sales vacancy.

launched_6mo.notes: Announced the private beta of Ethos Evals on November 6, 2026, within the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete public leadership roster or verifiable dated executive appointment/departure was found for the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Disclosed sales-intelligence, profile-enrichment and email-discovery/verification vendors; this does not establish use of a particular CRM platform.
